context.person: A person using a city service request application
context.journey_stage: City service request closed without a fix
context.user_goal: Review the closure reason and escalate if the accessibility impact remains unresolved.

product_state.current_state: An inspector visited the location. The request was closed as a capital-project issue.
known_facts: The request was closed as a capital-project issue.
The person can view the inspection note or submit an accessibility escalation.

current_content.heading: Heads up!
current_content.body: We're working on it. Check again later.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand city service request closed without a fix, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: View the inspection note and project classification.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Submit an accessibility escalation with additional evidence.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The reported barrier remains and has no scheduled repair.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Review the closure reason and escalate if the accessibility impact remains unresolved.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
